before.test/settings_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule SettingsTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "reads the application's configured label" do
    old = Application.get_env(:example, :label)
    on_exit(fn ->
      if old, do: Application.put_env(:example, :label, old), else: Application.delete_env(:example, :label)
    end)
    Application.put_env(:example, :label, "One")
    assert Settings.label() == "One"
  end
end
